subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - An element is focusable if it holds a sub-document, or if it is not inert (by presence on itself or an ancestor element, `Node::is_inert`), is no disabled form control and either has `tabindex >= 0` or, with no tabindex, is an `<a>`/`<area>` with `href` or a `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `frame`, `iframe` or `summary` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:742-774) — `disabled` read by its presence on a form control alone (`ElementData::is_disabled`: `can_be_disabled()` and the attribute present), any value, bare, `"false"` or `"true"`, so a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus; the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus (a disabled form control or an inert candidate skipped) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` read it (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — the presence reading ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «По наличию (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label), its narrowing to form controls and the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); HTML's focus fixup is built, in every document, so a node that holds focus when it becomes inert gives focus up at the flush, no DOM `blur` or `focusout` firing (the line below)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - `DocumentMutator::flush` calls `BaseDocument::clear_focus` where `focus_node_id` resolves to a node reading `is_inert()`, in every document, with no `inert` arm joining the attribute writes, so a subtree moved under an inert box is covered too; no DOM `blur` or `focusout` fires, and `disabled` and `hidden` take no part in it (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1051-1063; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:229-310) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

text: - Disabled-ness is keyed one way since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: the `DISABLED`/`ENABLED` element state (hence `:disabled`) reads the attribute's PRESENCE, and the pointer-move gate, `ClickTarget::Disabled`, `handle_click`'s walk gate, the Enter and Space activation and focusability read `ElementData::is_disabled` — that presence on a `button`, `input`, `select` or `textarea` alone (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — so `disabled="false"` and a bare `disabled=""` on a form control match `:disabled` and are not focusable, and a bare `disabled` set after creation takes its focusability away (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:480-485; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:333; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:472; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:832; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:332; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:349; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:59-62; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:78-96; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; before it focusability parsed the value as a bool and both stayed focusable (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-headless-stand/evidence/disabled-false-probe.txt)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A pointer click on a `button` (any type) or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, then submits the form owner when it is a submit button, and ends the walk matched — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; before it a submit button submitted without breaking the walk and every other button fell through to the unmatched clear of focus, so an accepted click on one left no element focused (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a disabled form control still stops the walk first, a disabled ancestor `div` not (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), and a click on any other element is unchanged — a CRUD row or the list still clears focus; on the stand a click focuses each stand button and Tab continues from it, and after an accepted driver `click` on `fx-before` it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1033-1045; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1164-1181; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:850-877; the restated `stand_act_obstructed`) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A click on a `select` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, clearing its typeahead and the document's text selection, a disabled select stopped by the walk's gate first so it neither focuses nor acts; on a single select each click also opens its list or closes one standing, two clicks on one point opening then closing, each focusing, and a row of an open list takes a click through `handle_click`'s `option` arm behind `click_lands_on_row`, while an option of a closed single select, under a group too, is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered` — on the stand the flight booker's two options among them); a `multiple` select's row takes a click through that arm (the `click_select_row` entry) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:947-960; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:179-211; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:249-270) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-select-popup/report.md

text: - A `details` or `dialog` carrying `open` holds the `OPEN` element state — `ElementData::flush_open_state`, run at element construction and on every `open` write or removal through the mutator — so `:open` matches it, in every document; activating a `details`'s first `summary` (above) toggles `open` through the mutator and so flips `:open`; `open_state` (4 tests, both layout modes) asserts `open` read from the attribute at construction, a write and a removal through the mutator moving it, and a summary's click and Enter flipping its `details` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/open_state.rs:54-143 — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md) (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:488-489; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:543-549; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:372-375; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:528-531; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:510) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md
